title: fix: propagate dispatcher origin to composed interceptors

target.summary: The dispatch wrapper only populates the origin from self[kUrl] when opts.origin is absent, preserving any caller-provided origin. This allows caller-controlled origin metadata to reach origin-dependent interceptors such as cache and deduplication, enabling cross-origin cache poisoning and state leakage.
